title: 将来进行时与将来完成时

markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 站到将来的某一刻去看：那时**正在做**，用 will be + ing；那时**已经做完**，用 will have + 过去分词。

uses.en: <<This time tomorrow>>, I[['ll be flying]] to London.
uses.en_zh: 明天这个时候，我正在飞往伦敦的路上。

uses.zh: 将来某一刻之前已经做完
uses.en: <<By>> Friday, we[['ll have fixed]] all the bugs.
uses.en_zh: 到周五，我们就把 bug 全修完了。

uses.en: [[Will]] you [[be using]] the meeting room this afternoon?
uses.en_zh: 你今天下午会用会议室吗？

signals: by the end of the year

continuous.title: 将来进行时
continuous.rule: 像给将来拍一张照片：那一刻你**正在干嘛**。所有人都用 will be，后面的动词加 ing。

examples.en: <<At 3 pm>>, I[['ll be presenting]] the demo.
examples.zh: 下午三点那会儿，我正在做演示。

examples.en: Don't call at seven. We[['ll be having]] dinner.
examples.zh: 别七点打来，那时我们正在吃晚饭。

examples.en: <<This time next week>>, she[['ll be lying]] on a beach.
examples.zh: 下周这个时候，她正躺在海滩上。

notes: 否定：I [[won't be working]] <<tomorrow>>.（我明天不上班。）
疑问：[[Will]] you [[be working]] <<tomorrow>>?（你明天上班吗？）

polite.title: 客气地问安排
polite.text: 问别人「你会不会……」时，用 Will you be + ing 更客气：你只是问他**本来的安排**，不是在求他做事。

examples.en: [[Will]] you [[be using]] your laptop at lunch? Could I borrow it?
examples.zh: 你午饭时要用笔记本吗？能借我用一下吗？
你会和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

examples.en: [[Will]] you [[be going]] past the post office?

polite.tip: Will you use the room? 语法没错，但听起来像在催对方做决定；加上 be + ing 就只是随口问问。

perfect.title: 将来完成时
perfect.rule: 站在将来某个点往回看：到那时，事情**已经做完了**。所有人都用 will have，后面跟过去分词。

examples.en: <<By the time>> you get here, I[['ll have finished]] the review.
examples.zh: 等你到这儿，我已经审完代码了。

examples.en: <<By>> June, I[['ll have worked]] here <<for>> five years.
examples.zh: 到六月，我在这儿就工作满五年了。
到那时商店已经关门了。

notes: 否定：I [[won't have finished]] <<by>> six.（六点前我还做不完。）

by.title: by：最晚到那时
by.text: **by** 是将来完成时的好朋友，意思是「**最晚**到那个时候」，不是「正好在那个时候」。

items.zh: 下午五点前我会发出去。

items.rule: by the time + 一般现在时
items.en: <<By the time>> she [[arrives]], we[['ll have started]].
items.zh: 等她到的时候，我们已经开始了。

items.en: <<By then>>, the update [[will have gone]] live.
items.zh: 到那时，更新已经上线了。

wrong.bad: By the time she ~~will arrive~~, we'll have started.
wrong.good: <<By the time>> she [[arrives]], we'll have started.

this.meaning: will be doing：那一刻正在吃

that.meaning: will have done：那时已经写完

commonMistakes.bad: This time tomorrow I ~~will fly~~ to Rome.
commonMistakes.good: This time tomorrow I[['ll be flying]] to Rome.
commonMistakes.why: 那一刻正在做，用 will be + ing。
will have 后面用过去分词。

commonMistakes.bad: By the time you ~~will get~~ here, I'll have left.
commonMistakes.good: <<By the time>> you [[get]] here, I'll have left.
commonMistakes.why: by the time 后面说将来，用一般现在时。
will be 后面的动词要加 ing。

quiz.prompt: By the time you read this, I ___ the office.
quiz.explain: 你读到的时候，我已经走了：[[will have left]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：明天这个时候，我正在飞往伦敦的路上。
quiz.answer: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to London.
accept: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.
This time tomorrow, I will be flying to London.
This time tomorrow I will be flying to London.
I'll be flying to London this time tomorrow.
I will be flying to London this time tomorrow.
quiz.explain: 那一刻正在做：I[['ll be flying]]。

quiz.prompt: Don't call at seven. We ___ dinner then.
quiz.explain: 七点那一刻正在吃：[[will be having]]。

quiz.prompt: At 3 pm, I ___ (present) the demo, so I can't answer the phone.
quiz.explain: 那一刻正在做：[[will be presenting]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：I will be working tomorrow.
accept: I will not be working tomorrow.

quiz.prompt: 哪一句是在客气地问对方的安排？
options: Will you use the room this afternoon?
Will you be using the room this afternoon?
quiz.answer: Will you be using the room this afternoon?
quiz.explain: Will you be + ing 只问安排，不像在要求对方：[[Will]] you [[be using]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 Will you be + ing 客气地问：对方会不会和我们一起吃晚饭（join us for dinner）。
quiz.answer: Will you be joining us for dinner?
accept: Will you be joining us for dinner tonight?

quiz.prompt: By June, I ___ (work) here for five years.
quiz.explain: 到六月就满五年：[[will have worked]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：By Friday, we'll have fix it.
quiz.answer: By Friday, we'll have fixed it.
accept: By Friday, we will have fixed it.
By Friday we'll have fixed it.
quiz.explain: will have 后面用过去分词：[[fixed]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：I will have finished by six.
quiz.answer: I won't have finished by six.
accept: I will not have finished by six.
quiz.explain: I [[won't have finished]]：will 后面加 not。

quiz.prompt: By the time she ___ (arrive), we'll have started.

traps.note: by the time 后面说将来，用一般现在时。

quiz.explain: <<By the time>> 后面用一般现在时：she [[arrive{s}]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：By the time you will get here, I'll have left.
quiz.answer: By the time you get here, I'll have left.
accept: By the time you get here, I will have left.
quiz.explain: <<By the time>> 后面用一般现在时：you [[get]]。

quiz.prompt: At 6, I ___ the report, so I can't talk then.
quiz.explain: 六点那会儿还在写：[[will be writing]]。

quiz.prompt: By 6, I ___ the report, so we can go out after that.
quiz.explain: 六点前已经写完：[[will have written]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：This time tomorrow I will fly to Rome.
quiz.answer: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Rome.
accept: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Rome.
This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Rome.
quiz.explain: 那一刻正在飞：[[will be flying]]。

openTask.prompt: 想象下周五下午五点：用将来进行时说那时你正在做什么，再用将来完成时说那时你已经做完了什么。一共 3 句。
rules: 将来进行时 = will be + 动词 ing
将来完成时 = will have + 过去分词
by the time 后面说将来，用一般现在时
openTask.note: 规则判 will be + ing 和 will have + 过去分词（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
